Lago is an open-source, self-hostable billing and usage-metering platform for SaaS and online services.

Track API calls, compute, seats, storage, and other usage, then manage pricing, credits, subscriptions, invoices, and payments.

More details & alternatives: https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/tool.html?id=lago
